reply.text: I'm sorry you're going through a breakup, and I'm glad you're reaching for the gym instead of sitting with it alone. Training can give your head something solid to hold onto, and I'll put that together for you. Tell me what you've got: how many days a week you can get in, and whether you'd rather lift, run, or mix both. I'll build it around that, and you can hit the Build it button under this reply once we've settled the details. If the hurt starts feeling heavier than a rough stretch, please talk to someone you trust or a professional, not just me.
